sources.title: Parakeet Redux: is a 178 MB speech model useful in the real world?
sources.snippet: 5 Oct 2026 · 13 min read · Machine learning Parakeet Redux: is a 178 MB speech model useful in the real world? Moondream squeezed NVIDIA's Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 into 178 MB with ternary weights. I tested it against its original, five other open models and three cloud APIs on a laptop and a Tesla T4: what it keeps, what it gives up, and where it's worth using.
